writeup: Mountain Hardwear's Ghost Whisperer down pant is an 800-fill ultralight insulated pant that packs into its own pocket, making it an easy camp or layering piece. Woot has the black men's Medium Short for $58.99, while CampSaver charges $268 even after its 20% clothing code and Ourland Outdoor lists it at $335. That is about 77% below the cheapest store we found.
